cipher.name: QwertyShiftCipher
cipher.idea: A monoalphabetic substitution cipher based on shifting keys on a standard QWERTY keyboard layout. Each letter is replaced by the letter immediately to its right on a standard QWERTY keyboard. The rows wrap around: 'p' wraps to 'q', 'l' wraps to 'a', and 'm' wraps to 'z'. Case is preserved, and all non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
Map each letter to the letter immediately to its right in its respective QWERTY row. The rows are defined as:
Row 1: q->w, w->e, e->r, r->t, t->y, y->u, u->i, i->o, o->p, p->q
Row 2: a->s, s->d, d->f, f->g, g->h, h->j, j->k, k->l, l->a
Row 3: z->x, x->c, c->v, v->b, b->n, n->m, m->z

Case is preserved (e.g., 'Q' maps to 'W', 'p' maps to 'q'). All digits, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
Map each letter to the letter immediately to its left in its respective QWERTY row. The rows are defined as:
Row 1: q->p, w->q, e->w, r->e, t->r, y->t, u->y, i->u, o->i, p->o
Row 2: a->l, s->a, d->s, f->d, g->f, h->g, j->h, k->j, l->k
Row 3: z->m, x->z, c->x, v->c, b->v, n->b, m->n
